official_patch: V9.9 模组汉化修复补丁基线
changes:
修复 v0.1.22 的独立 BetterSpino 与 SweetStructures 根目录容器未被客户端发现的问题。
  Fixes v0.1.22, where independent BetterSpino and SweetStructures root containers were not discovered by the client.

将 195 个 Extra Boss 资产包和 39 个 Sweet Structures 资产包融合进客户端扫描的 ShooterGame-Windows_P 根容器。
  Fuses 195 Extra Boss packages and 39 Sweet Structures packages into the client-scanned ShooterGame-Windows_P root container.

每个 ZIP 只保留 pakchunk9999-Windows_P.pak 和 ShooterGame-Windows_P.pak/.ucas/.utoc 四个游戏文件。
  Each ZIP now contains only four game files: pakchunk9999-Windows_P.pak and ShooterGame-Windows_P.pak/.ucas/.utoc.
validation:
Both root IoStore containers passed retoc verify. A bilingual root-container roundtrip read back the translated Dodorex Boss Summoner and Graham Cracker Tileset asset fields. ZIP CRC and SHA-256 checks passed.
两个根 IoStore 容器均通过 retoc verify。双语根容器往返回读确认渡渡霸王龙 Boss 召唤器与全麦饼干建筑套件资产字段已翻译。ZIP CRC 和 SHA-256 校验均通过。
risk_notice:
安装 v0.1.23 前删除 v0.1.22 的 BetterSpinoShooterGame-Windows_P.* 与 SweetStructuresShooterGame-Windows_P.*；普通中文包与双语包二选一。
Before installing v0.1.23, remove v0.1.22 BetterSpinoShooterGame-Windows_P.* and SweetStructuresShooterGame-Windows_P.* files. Choose either the normal or bilingual ZIP.
